research.title: Elastic goes all-in on Hacker Summer Camp at Black Hat and DEF CON in Las Vegas
research.summary: At Elastic, we know that the best way to build security tools is to bring them to the community, have security pros use them, and let them tell us what features and functionality matter and why. This year, we’re excited to do this at Black Hat and DEFCON,.

research.title: CVE-2026-20316 | Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center Static Credential Vulnerability
research.summary: CVE-2026-20316 is a static credential vulnerability affecting Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC), Cisco’s centralized management platform for Secure Firewall deployments. The vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to authenticate.
